cases.name: help-clone
cases.stdout:
Clone a repository into a new directory.

Clones a repository into a newly created directory and creates remote-tracking branches for each branch in the cloned repository.

Usage: git clone [OPTIONS] <REMOTE> [DIRECTORY]

Arguments:
  <REMOTE>
          The repository to clone from

  [DIRECTORY]
          The directory to clone into

Options:
      --depth <DEPTH>
          Create a shallow clone with this many commits

      --branch <branch_name>
          Check out this branch instead of the remote's HEAD

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -v, --verbose  Show remote URLs
  -h, --help     Print help
